name: card-skill
title_zh: 把文字与证据渲染成统一风格的分享卡片
tagline_zh: 笔记、引文、论点、仓库说明、微信读书划线——丢进来就出一张能直接发的 PNG。不用再为每张图重新调样式。
tagline_en: Drop in notes, quotes, arguments, repo docs, or WeRead highlights—get a share-ready PNG in one consistent visual.
desc_en: Render text and evidence into polished, shareable PNG visuals with one consistent Kenny Style visual grammar. Use this skill whenever the user asks to turn words, notes, articles, quotes, arguments, stories, open-source repository or tool material, technical commands/workflows, explicit WeChat Reading highlights/thoughts, or WeChat Reading personal statistics into an 信息图/infographic, 海报/poster, 卡片
why_zh: 它不只是一个渲染器，而是一套贯穿所有卡片的视觉语法：同一字体、间距、强调层级，让不同来源的内容看起来像。
why_en: Not just a renderer—it enforces one visual grammar across every card: same type, spacing, and emphasis hierarchy, so disparate.
limit_zh: 只输出 PNG 静态图，不生成 HTML/PDF；排版规则固定为 Kenny Style，不接受自定义主题。
limit_en: PNG only—no HTML/PDF. Styling is locked to Kenny Style, no custom themes. Content beyond one screen is truncated, not paginated; you must split.
